classification: source-truth and probability-consumption repair; not a fitted candidate and not betting authorization
incident: Kwan-shaped impossible player-level Statcast pair: barrel_rate=0.50 and hard_hit_percent=9.4 normalized to 0.094, allowing barrel_rate > hard_hit_rate to reach a rich-feature HR path.

root_cause.raw_parser: The player-level CSV parser applied a generic unit normalizer independently to barrel_rate and hard_hit_percent without enforcing their shared denominator/subset relationship.
root_cause.consumption: Rich-feature overrides could supply barrel and hard-hit values that reached H_power and H_quality before the HR and total-bases probability calculations without a final cross-field contract.

source_to_probability_map.raw_profile_boundary: src/data/savant.py::SavantClient.apply_league_fallback validates raw pair before fallback and validates the resolved profile after fallback
source_to_probability_map.rich_override_boundary: src/simulation/pa_simulator.py::HybridPASimulator._build_latent_profile validates a complete rich pair before selecting overrides

market_consumption.hr_over_0_5: H_power and H_quality enter the HR-on-ball-in-play calculation, which becomes a per-PA HR probability and then a HR tail.
market_consumption.hits: The shared PA distribution is constructed after the same latent profile boundary.
market_consumption.total_bases: The shared PA distribution and hit-type tails are constructed after the same latent profile boundary.

safe_remediation.contract: Rates must be finite fractions in [0,1]; when both are present, barrel_rate must not exceed hard_hit_rate. Rich overrides must provide both rates or neither.
safe_remediation.fail_closed: Invalid, contradictory, or partial rich pairs raise StatcastBattedBallContractError before fallback, latent-feature construction, or probability consumption.
prohibited_remedies: substituting a league average for a contradictory input

cases: Kwan-shaped player-level parser contradiction is quarantined through the public CSV ingestion path
valid player-level fractional/percent pair is preserved as 0.05 and 0.40
impossible rich override is rejected before probability construction
partial rich override is rejected before probability construction

artifact_hashes.data_and_feature_artifacts: No permissible historical player-level raw receipt or point-in-time feature artifact was found for this parser seam; none was reconstructed, synthesized, or hashed. Existing archives remain untouched.

chronological_evaluation.reason: This is a fail-closed integrity repair, not a fitted probability change. Re-running old rows without raw receipt provenance would either rewrite history or invent a reconstruction. The repair therefore has no valid historical performance claim.
chronological_evaluation.next_eligible_evidence: Fresh, timestamped, point-in-time Statcast-source receipt that passes this contract, followed by separately locked chronological evaluation against each market's required baselines.

single_highest_value_next_action: Complete the broader active input-to-probability defect register, then collect fresh valid pregame receipts under the repaired contract; only then fit or adjudicate a new challenger on its predeclared chronological protocol.
